hypothesis: Six include_chart controls default true and attach PNGs; descriptions do not state their input-token cost. An agent may request an unnecessary chart for a short answer.
fairness: The task asks for yes/no, a short list, or a single number. A chart is unnecessary for that requested answer form. Prompts contain no tool or parameter names. We score chart suppression explicitly as authorized by the user; this is a response-format preference benchmark, not evidence that PopHIVE data or charts are wrong.

tasks.prompt: Quick yes or no: is flu rising in Texas right now?
tasks.pass: Exactly one get_current_status call; disease flu; geography Texas or TX; include_chart explicitly false.

tasks.prompt: Which 3 states have the highest RSV right now? Just list them.
tasks.pass: Exactly one get_map call; disease RSV; include_chart explicitly false. Record top_n, but do not score it.

tasks.prompt: What's the kindergarten MMR vaccination rate in Idaho?
tasks.pass: Exactly one get_coverage call; vaccine explicitly mmr; geography Idaho or ID; include_chart explicitly false.

tasks.prompt: What diseases and topics does PopHIVE track?
tasks.pass: Exactly one get_data call with the disease argument absent. Explicit null counts as present and fails.

setup.experiment: One paired setup experiment, comprising exactly two target tool calls before final freeze.
setup.purpose: Confirm anonymous execution and measure full non-image text and incremental image-part input tokens.

candidate_rule: Change only the six include_chart parameter descriptions: PNG image attachment, approximately N additional image-input tokens from this setup chart (cost varies by chart dimensions/content), default true, set false for short answers or numbers. Keep all names, schema constraints/defaults, annotations and other text identical. N is rounded to the nearest 10 image-input tokens from the with-chart setup response; report the unrounded count.
system: You are a helpful assistant. Use the available tools to answer the user.
server_instructions: Saved as evidence but not injected into the generation system prompt; identical neutral system and all seven provider tool definitions in both conditions.
context: No extra context block or tool/parameter hints.
argument_scoring: Validate against frozen input schema without inserting defaults. Case-insensitive exact disease/vaccine values; trimmed Texas/TX and Idaho/ID. Other schema-valid arguments are recorded but unscored; P2 top_n is explicitly unscored. Wrong tool, omitted/true include_chart for P1-P3, wrong/missing required scored values, absent/multiple calls or invalid schema fails. No final answer is generated.
execution: Only frozen readOnlyHint true and not destructiveHint true names execute. Block unknown/write/destructive tools at dispatch as wrong_tool. Allowed schema-valid first calls execute even if they fail a task predicate, preserving their actual result context.
result_tokens: Complete MCP response: recursively replace image-block base64 data with numbered image references in the full JSON envelope, then attach the image bytes as native Anthropic image content parts. Text tokens = envelope-only countTokens input_tokens; image tokens = full mixed count minus that text count; total = mixed count. Includes all content, structuredContent and metadata. No approximate counts and no base64-as-text counting.
privacy: Public aggregate data; no target credentials. Scan/redact configured secrets and bearer/API-key-shaped values before saving or counting; never print secret values. Image bytes remain images. No response fed back to generation.
retention: Keep every model attempt, blocked/error/empty outcome, complete response, image, actual tool arguments, request log, token counts and count errors. No retries, replacements, prompt revision, or patch tuning after freeze.
consistency: Per task/condition, flag disagreement in selected tool/arguments, pass/failure, response token tuple, and image count; do not hide disagreement.
verdict_order: Use src/core/verdict.ts evaluateVerdict unchanged: regression first (control loss or task delta <=-2); then insufficient-data/incomplete => inconclusive; then all deltas >=0 plus a non-control gain >=2 => improved; otherwise inconclusive. A perfect baseline is reported plainly; result-token differences alone do not make Improved.
freeze: Commit this setup pre-registration before any provider call. After the two setup calls and token counts, save candidate/registration/metadata/source hashes and commit them before any generation trial. Any tool/hash/model drift stops the run.
